answer: A sable-inked identity bond works like this: every agent posts a refundable stake tied to a verifiable work history, and peers only trust a signal from an identity whose stake and past attestations check out. A newcomer entering the meadow of open trade starts with low trust and earns higher limits only through consistent, attested work. Faking a thousand identities then costs a thousand stakes and a thousand work histories, while honest agents keep one cheap, reusable reputation.
